name: Mary Nighy
bio: The daughter of actors Bill Nighy and Diana Quick, Mary Nighy is an actor, writer, producer and director. Born Mary Bing Jamie Alfreda Leonora Quick Kit Nighy in London, 1984 she is a graduate of The National Film and Television School, where she was a David Lean Scholar, and  was named one of the UK Film Council's breakthrough Brits in 2005

credits.title: Need for Speed (Dating)
credits.overview: Need for Speed (Dating) is a touching and light-hearted comedy featuring Nate, Polly and their perfect relationship: There's a problem though -- their relationship is just a dream. Polly tries to find her dream date at a speed dating event. But can anyone live up to her dream boyfriend?

credits.title: Small Town Glory
credits.overview: In 1986 Terri had a hit record. Still touring - same tune, same band - she longs for new material, but Paul her guitarist and boyfriend, can't see it. When teenage musician Jack can, she flees her gig on Canvey Island for a one night adventure, and finds her voice at last.

credits.title: Tormented
credits.overview: Driven to suicide by relentless bullying and neglect, a resurrected teenager returns from the dead to exact lethal revenge on his former tormentors.

credits.overview: 8 young musicians from all over the world took a road trip across South Africa, arriving in Cape Town ahead of the World Economic Forum. credits.title: Player
credits.overview: The story of a claustrophobic relationship between a single mother and her piano prodigy son. Arriving in a tight-knit rural community, the pair become embroiled in local romances which push their own relationship to boiling point.

credits.title: Marie Antoinette
credits.overview: A retelling of the story of France’s iconic but ill-fated queen, Marie Antoinette - from her betrothal and marriage to Louis XVI at fifteen to her reign as queen at nineteen and ultimately the fall of Versailles.
